description: Observe mode returns allow while preserving the deny as effectiveVerdict and wouldDeny.
laneYaml:
id: rt-observe-mode
version: 1
priority: 2000
mode: observe
purpose: Observe deny-worthy commands without blocking.
appliesTo: { surfaces: [claude-code], agents: ['rt-observe-mode'] }
failMode: { default: closed, READ: open }
rules:
  deny:
    - id: dangerous-shell
      tool: [Bash]
  allow: []
  judge: []
  approve: []
defaultVerdict: allow
approval: { channels: [dashboard], timeoutSec: 1 }
judge: { escalateBelow: 0.7, dataPolicy: redacted }
